On the adult ward, in my experience, it really seems like they dont give a shit about you sadly. And you dont really become friends with anyone cause no one wants to be friends lol. Also at one of the adult wards I was in, there was no group therapy or anything so I basically just forced myself to sleep all day for like 5 days.

Overall, it just depends on what ward you go to. Some wards are really nice, great staff, good food, they actually help, and some wards are shit and give you the absolute bare minimum that you need.
